foundry_calls.text: Sharpen it? Aye. Double rate, after yesterday. The steel forgives faster than I do.
foundry_calls.speaker: Marta

foundry_calls.text: She holds out a calloused palm for the coin first, and doesn't look at you while she waits.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

llm_calls: [Aria]: I come back the next morning and ask Marta to sharpen my blade.
